verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents custom rules that automate code review comments through its GitHub integration, plus alerts, notifications and tickets for findings. Scans run automatically on push and pull/merge request events, and rule-defined fixes can be applied with --autofix. However, it is a detection-rule system tied to scan events, not a general event-to-action rule engine, and the event triggers depend on CI jobs. Missing for 10: user-configurable event→action automation rules beyond code-scan findings, documented action workflow configuration (conditions, routing), webhooks or arbitrary action targets, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
